summary:
This game is about traveling through Mars, after choosing your rocket, propulsion system, what rover you want to drive with on Mars and the difficulty level of after you buy your chosen rover, rocket and propulsion system. Once you finish buying everything, you can navigate through space and finally, reach the surface of Mars and you can explore.
Thank You..
details:
1. Mission Assembly

Your journey in Galaxy Gamers begins in the Orbital Hangar, where your bank account starts with 260,00,000 and every pre-launch decision impacts how your spacecraft handles:

  • Select Your Rocket: Choose between two launch vehicles.
  • Choose Your Propulsion: Pick between two propulsion systems.
  • Equip Your Rover: Select one of four Mars rovers.

2. Deep Space Transit

Once your loadout is locked in, hitting Launch Mission blasts you into deep space. Taking direct helm of your rocket,you must navigate a treacherous transit corridor filled with drifting space debris and incoming asteroid fields.

3. Martian Surface Exploration

Surviving the asteroid belt triggers a Mission Complete confirmation before seamlessly transitioning you into the first-person Point of View (POV) of your chosen rover on the Martian surface. From the driver's seat, the game shifts from high-stakes arcade evasion to open-world planetary exploration.
